description: Port of SQLFluff 4.4.0's AM09 (ambiguous.order_by_limit): report each SELECT containing LIMIT or OFFSET without a direct ORDER BY; anchor the first relevant LIMIT, or OFFSET when LIMIT is absent.

violation.message: LIMIT and OFFSET are used without ORDER BY, which may lead to non-deterministic results.
